rows.label: Orokin Reactor
rows.note: Rank 3 Lawful sacrifice; Nightwave sells one for 75 Cred

rows.label: Aya
rows.note: 2 at Rank 4 Crusader, 3 at Rank 5 Maxim

conditions: Rank-ups also cost 940,000 credits in total. Standing caps at 132,000 at Maxim and lower before; earning past a rank's maximum is wasted.

disclosures.title: why 365,000
disclosures.body: 240,000 standing carries the five rank-ups to Maxim (5,000 / 22,000 / 44,000 / 70,000 / 99,000). The 125,000-standing purchase is then farmed on top; Maxim's bar holds 132,000, enough to bank it.

rows.label: Telos Boltor
rows.note: arrives built, no Foundry step; needs a free weapon slot

conditions: The free item you pick at Maxim can never be a Syndicate weapon; the Boltor is always a separate 125,000-standing purchase.
Mastery Rank 12 is required both to buy it and to receive it in a trade.
bonuses: Telos Boltace (125,000) and Telos Akbolto (100,000) sell from the same Maxim rank.
